title: Morgiana’s Clever Plan
logline: Morgiana unmasks the thieves' leader by the ring on his hand, holds him in the locked courtyard with nothing but her wits until the guards come, and when the treasure has gone back to its owners she chooses her own reward: an honest shop of her own.
moral: Wisdom and honesty are worth more than gold, and a clear head can stop a danger without a single blow.
tone: Finale: a tight, witty stand-off in the lantern-lit night courtyard (suspense played through eyes, a key and two name tags, never through weapons), then bright daylight for justice done, a tender sunset thank-you, and a golden, generous ending in the market. Family-friendly throughout.

beats.summary: Morgiana folds back the guest's long cuff as she hands him his forgotten gift.
Insert: the silver ring with the split blue stone, the one she saw on the night of the jars.
She names the proof; a band of light shows the leader of the thieves inside the fine clothes.
He runs to the courtyard gate: barred and padlocked. Morgiana has the key.
She keeps Ali Baba back: nobody leaves before the guards arrive; spear tips bob along the wall top.
The mask goes back on, but he has forgotten his own false name.
The nephew's question gets a different name: two tags that do not match, and everyone leans in.
Guards enter by the other door; he raises empty hands. No fight.
The ring identifies him and a map to the cave is found in his sash.
He is led away to the judge with one last look at Morgiana.
Ali Baba opens the rock one last time, for the guards.
The stolen things go back to their owners in the nearby towns.
The household rises to thank Morgiana.
Gold did not save us; your wisdom did.
The reward: three futures, and the choice is hers.
She chooses a shop in the market.
The shop opens: a level scale and a queue that trusts it.
Ali Baba trades honestly and lets the cave go.
Remember clever Morgiana! Lamps light; THE END.

scenes.summary: Golden late afternoon. An old storyteller under the arch begins the tale of the forty thieves; the townspeople all turn and point down the street: remember clever Morgiana! She lights her lamps one by one, and the film and the series end.

actions.action: The light has turned golden. An old storyteller sits on the low wall by the arch; three children drop down cross-legged in front of him
actions.acting: children sit one after another (stagger); storyteller's hands rise

actions.action: He raises a finger and begins; the baker and the old neighbour stop to listen
actions.acting: story hands: slow, wide; listeners' gazes on him

actions.action: A picture balloon opens above him: a line of small rider silhouettes galloping along a ridge

actions.action: The baker laughs and shakes his head; he turns and points down the street
actions.acting: big arm on a flow key, body turn with a blink

actions.action: One after another every arm in the group goes out the same way: the old neighbour's broom, the apprentice, the children with both hands, even Ali Baba from his woodpile with a proud grin
actions.acting: six points on six delays (stagger 3 frames each); the picture balloon folds away

actions.action: One big balloon from the whole group: REMEMBER CLEVER MORGIANA!
actions.acting: all mouths on threes, out of step; the camera pans left along the arms

actions.action: At the end of the arms: Morgiana at her shop, lighting the first lamp of the evening with a taper; she looks up at the noise
actions.acting: flame pops with a small glow; eyes up, a blink, surprise then the smile

actions.action: She laughs, shakes her head at them and gives a small wave with the taper hand; the turquoise awning and her scarf catch the gold light
actions.acting: scarf tail late; blush; the cat on the counter yawns

actions.action: The other seven lamps light along the shelf one by one, each with its own halo
actions.acting: 0.15 s apart, flicker at 12 fps on separate seeds

actions.acting: title on at 142.3, held to the last frame

actions.action: Ali Baba leads the donkey up to the shop with the kid riding on the firewood; the nephew and the wife arrive from the left; he tips his turban to Morgiana and she bows back, laughing
actions.acting: walks without sliding, each on its own phase; vermilion and turquoise side by side under the lamps

actions.action: Moving hold to the end: lamps flicker, awning hem ripples, swallows cross the sky, the first star comes out, the cat's tail curls; Morgiana trims one last lamp
actions.acting: nothing frozen: idle life on every figure, camera drifting 10 units

ending.description: The townspeople's shared balloon REMEMBER CLEVER MORGIANA! on its word (139.0); Morgiana lights her first lamp and waves (140.3-141.6); the remaining lamps light one by one, THE END flickers on at 142.3 and is held to 147.13 while the family gathers at the shop, with vermilion and turquoise side by side under the lamps. The series ends on THE END.

subtitles.ar: كشفت مرجانة كمّ الرجل،|فظهر الخاتم الفضي ذو الحجر الأزرق المشقوق الذي رأته في ليلة الجرار.|قالت: «هذا دليل على هويتك».
subtitles.en: Morgiana exposed the man’s sleeve,|revealing the silver ring with a split blue stone she had seen on the night of the jars.|“This proves who you are,” she said.

subtitles.ar: تراجع الرجل خطوة، وحاول فتح باب الفناء، لكنه وجده مغلقًا.|أشارت مرجانة إلى علي بابا كي يبقى بعيدًا، ثم قالت: «لن يخرج أحد قبل وصول الحراس».
subtitles.en: The man stepped back and tried opening the courtyard gate, but found it locked.|Morgiana motioned for Ali Baba to stay back, then said, “Nobody leaves before the guards arrive.”

subtitles.ar: حاول الرجل إقناعهم بأنه مجرد تاجر مسافر،|لكنه نسي الاسم الذي اختاره لنفسه.|وعندما سأله ابن الأخ عن متجره، أجاب باسم مختلف، فازداد الجميع شكًا فيه.
subtitles.en: The man tried to persuade them that he was merely a traveling merchant,|but forgot the false name he had chosen.|Asked about his shop by the nephew, he gave a different name, increasing everyone’s suspicion.

subtitles.ar: دخل الحراس من الباب الآخر وأوقفوا الرجل بلا قتال.|عرفته مرجانة بخاتمه، ووجدوا معه خريطة طريق الكهف.|اقتادوه إلى القاضي.
subtitles.en: Guards entered through the other door and stopped him without a fight.|Morgiana identified him by his ring; they also found a map to the cave.|They took him to the judge.

subtitles.ar: دل علي بابا الحراس على الصخرة التي تخفي الكنز.|جمعوا الأشياء المسروقة بعناية، ثم بدأوا البحث عن أصحابها في المدن القريبة،|حتى يعود الحق إلى أصحابه.
subtitles.en: Ali Baba led the guards to the rock hiding the treasure.|They carefully collected the stolen goods and searched neighboring towns for their owners,|so that what had been taken could be returned.

subtitles.ar: اجتمع أهل البيت في المساء، وشكروا مرجانة على شجاعتها وحسن تفكيرها.|قال علي بابا: «لم ينقذنا الذهب، بل حكمتك».|وقدم لها مكافأة تختار بها مستقبلها بنفسها.
subtitles.en: That evening the household gathered and thanked Morgiana for her courage and clear thinking.|Ali Baba said, “Gold did not save us; your wisdom did.”|He gave her a reward to choose her own future.

subtitles.ar: ابتسمت مرجانة وقالت إنها ستفتح متجرًا في السوق.|ساعدتها الأسرة، فصار لها عمل مستقل يثق الناس بأمانته.
subtitles.en: Morgiana smiled and said she would open a shop in the market.|The family helped her build an independent business trusted for its honesty.

subtitles.ar: أما علي بابا فظل يعمل ويتاجر بأمانة، ولم يعد إلى الكهف سرًا.|وكلما ذكر أحد قصة اللصوص الأربعين، قال أهل البلدة: «تذكروا مرجانة الذكية!»
subtitles.en: Ali Baba continued to work and trade honestly, never secretly returning to the cave.|Whenever anyone mentioned the forty thieves, townspeople would say, “Remember clever Morgiana!”

new_assets.description: ALI-05's abNewMerchant has one cuff field for both sleeves; this film needs the right cuff folded back to the wrist while the left still hangs (cuffR, cuffL 0..1), a folded-cuff drawing at the wrist, and a feather droop field for the surrender.

new_assets.name: marketDusk model
new_assets.description: A golden late-afternoon colour model of the series market for the last scene. No new geometry. (The feast uses the existing ALI-04 evening courtyard.)
new_assets.implementation: marketDusk: Library marketStreet over a baked apricot to teal abGrad sky with pink abCloud undersides, plus a soft warm abGlaze from the left; no multiply over the cast.

new_assets.name: handOver (give and take with weight)
new_assets.description: A small helper for the many hand-overs in this film (gift box, casket, tray, carpet, pot, toy, coins): the giver's hands travel to a meeting point, the object changes owner on a given time, the receiver's hands dip with the weight and settle, both pairs of eyes on the object and then on each other. The 'tossTo' idea of the guide without the toss.
new_assets.implementation: handOver(t, t0, from, to, w) returns {pos, owner, dip}: pos = flow between the two hand world points over 0.4 s, owner switches at t0, dip = w * impactSquash(t, t0) applied to the receiver's hand targets and 0.3 of it to tip. Pure function of t; sample with celStep.

owner_questions: The film opens on the last picture of ALI-05 (night courtyard, Morgiana in the doorway with the gift, the guest at the barred gate) and uses that plan's guest, nephew, gift box, barred gate and shop front; the guest walks back for his gift, which lets her fold back the long cuff that hid the ring; default: as described.

The script says he forgot his false name and gave a different one without naming either; the balloons use HASAN and then KARIM'S as invented names; default: kept (ALI-05 gives him no name on screen and his shop sign is only a lamp picture).
Family-friendly capture: the guards hold their spears upright, nobody touches him, he raises empty hands and is walked out with a loose rope at his wrists; default: as described.
The locked gate: ALI-05 has Morgiana lower the bar; this film adds a padlock on it and the key on a turquoise ribbon at her sash; default: included.

The return of the stolen goods is shown as three small hand-overs (a weaver's carpet, a potter's pot of savings, a girl's brass horse); default: these three.

Ali Baba's line about gold is acted with a single gold coin that he drops on the table, and the reward is a small casket with a purse, shown with three possible futures in a thought cloud (a shop, a road, a house); default: included.
